task_name: World 109 Task A/B  -  ClickUp Milestone Cutoff & Xero 10% Australian GST Capitalization Audit

rubric.description: Decomposes QBO invoice INV-7710 ($28,000.00 billed Sep 29) into $15,500.00 earned September retainer revenue and $12,500.00 uncompleted ClickUp milestone deferred to 2410 Unearned Revenue.
Decomposes Xero bill BILL-AU-304 ($68,200.00 GST-inclusive capital purchase) into $62,000.00 ex-GST Fixed Asset basis and $6,200.00 refundable GST Input Tax Credit.

Explains that because the ClickUp milestone on INV-7710 was not completed until October 2, recognizing the full $28,000.00 in September violates accrual cutoff (Dr Revenue $12,500.00 / Cr 2410 Unearned Revenue $12,500.00).

Explains that under Australian GST rules in Xero, the 1/11th GST component ($6,200.00 on $68,200.00) is a recoverable Input Tax Credit in Account 820 GST and must NOT be capitalized into depreciable machinery cost.
Computes the exact 10% GST math: $68,200.00 / 1.10 = $62,000.00 ex-GST asset cost and $68,200.00 - $62,000.00 = $6,200.00 GST credit.
Identifies the overstatement of Fixed Assets ($6,200.00) and future depreciation if the GST-inclusive total ($68,200.00) is capitalized.
Verifies ClickUp operational delivery timestamps against QBO invoice dates before certifying monthly agency revenue.
Provides the exact Xero correcting entry on BILL-AU-304: Dr 820 GST Input Tax Credit $6,200.00 / Cr Fixed Assets  -  Plant & Equipment $6,200.00.

prompt: Perform a comprehensive Fractional COO Multi-ERP & International Tax Bridges review using the world files (`trades_and_erp_bridge_schedules_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.
gold_output:
World 109 Task B  -  ClickUp Milestone Cutoff & Xero 10% Australian GST Capitalization Audit:
1. ClickUp-to-QBO Milestone Cutoff (INV-7710): Of the $28,000.00 invoice billed Sep 29, $15,500.00 is earned September retainer revenue and $12,500.00 is an uncompleted ClickUp milestone (completed October 2) that must be deferred via Dr Revenue $12,500.00 / Cr 2410 Unearned Revenue $12,500.00.
2. Xero Australian 10% GST Capitalization (BILL-AU-304): The $68,200.00 GST-inclusive CNC press brake purchase equals $68,200.00 / 1.10 = $62,000.00 ex-GST depreciable Fixed Asset basis plus $6,200.00 refundable GST Input Tax Credit ($68,200.00 - $62,000.00 = $6,200.00). Capitalizing the GST-inclusive total overstates Fixed Assets by $6,200.00; record correcting entry Dr 820 GST Input Tax Credit $6,200.00 / Cr Fixed Assets  -  Plant & Equipment $6,200.00.
